title: Good things are happening, too.
description: A little perspective on the week in AI. The progress worth noticing, and the context worth keeping.
subject: Good things are happening, too.
intro: Our original two-story pilot edition. Both stories draw on MIT reporting; this small sample is not a comprehensive survey of the week.

stories.title: A helping hand for medics, beyond the hospital
stories.event_date: Award and technology-transfer update reported September 11; development predates this week.
stories.summary: AI-GUIDE combines handheld ultrasound with software that helps a user place a guidewire and catheter. MIT reported a technology-transfer award for the team behind it as the prototype moves toward commercialization.
stories.ai_role: AI assists the guidance process using ultrasound images.
stories.why_it_matters: The intended benefit is to make a demanding procedure more accessible to medics away from a hospital.
stories.caveat: This is a development and transfer update, not new evidence of lives saved at scale or proof of broad availability.

sources.title: MIT News · September 11, 2026
sources.note: First-party reporting from the developing institution.

stories.title: Helping teachers make AI less of a black box
stories.event_date: Workshop held in July 2026; report published September 9.
stories.summary: MIT described a weeklong summer pilot in which 19 higher-education participants explored teaching AI across disciplines and adapting materials for their classrooms.
stories.ai_role: AI is the subject of instruction, not an automated replacement for teachers.
stories.why_it_matters: Helping instructors explain and question AI could give students greater understanding and agency.
stories.caveat: A completed workshop does not yet establish improved student learning outcomes.
